description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'NationalityDao' responsible for database operations related to 'Nationality' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, querying by various filters, pagination, and validation of nationality data.

classes.name: NationalityDao
classes.description: A DAO class responsible for handling database operations related to the 'Nationality' entity, including retrieval, saving, counting, and deletion of nationality records.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Persists a Nationality entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Nationality entities based on search filter parameters using pagination.

methods.name: getNationalityListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for navigating through nationalities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of Nationality entities matching the search filter.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Retrieves a Nationality entity by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingNationalityIds
methods.description: Returns an array of existing nationality IDs that match the provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Returns a Nationality entity matching the given name, or null if none exists.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes multiple Nationality records identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks whether a nationality with the specified name already exists in the database.
